description: This file serves as the entry point for a React-based web application. It imports necessary libraries, including React and ReactDOM, along with CSS styles and the main App component. It initializes the React application by creating a root element and rendering the App component within React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the DOM.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the specified React component tree into the root DOM node.
